Weyerhaeuser Company Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2019. Weyerhaeuser Company announced earnings results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2019. For the third quarter, the company announced operating income was USD 202 million compared to USD 337 million a year ago. Net income was USD 99 million compared to USD 255 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 0.13 compared to USD 0.34 a year ago. For the nine months, operating income was USD 562 million compared to USD 1,217 million a year ago. SEATTLE, JULY 8, 2021 /PRNEWSWIRE/ --  WEYERHAEUSER COMPANY  (NYSE: WY) TODAY ANNOUNCED THE COMPLETION OF THE SALE OF 145,000 ACRES OF TIMBERLANDS IN THE NORTH CASCADES REGION OF WASHINGTON TO HAMPTON RESOURCES FOR $266 MILLION. THE TRANSACTION WAS ANNOUNCED IN APRIL 2021 , AND THE COMPANY ANTICIPATES NO TAX LIABILITY IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE SALE.
